g.text: If replacement fails, the old folder is restored.
Heightmap imports fill DEM gaps, then export EXR.
Hole overlays build a class raster and paint the
Terrain3D control map, with bunkers as sand zones.
One course can contain many holes.
Each imported line becomes one hole.
Tee colours can be trimmed per course.
The export is one scene for the full course,
course.gd is a one-line subclass of CoursePlay.
Hole geometry is read at runtime from course.json
and the HoleMarkers nodes, not baked into the script.
